concerns.text: FR-013 (linear mixed‑effects regression) is defined in the spec but has no corresponding task, script, or output listed in the implementation plan. The plan’s Phase/Task table never mentions a mixed‑effects model, leaving this functional requirement unaddressed.
The plan references FR‑007 (resource guardrails) in Phase 11, yet FR‑007 does not exist in the specification. This constitutes an over‑reach—adding a requirement that the spec never asked for.
